$description: Saklolo design tokens (W3C DTCG). Three tiers: primitive (raw values), semantic (intent), component. Semantic $value is the light theme; $extensions.saklolo.dark is the dark theme. Edit here, then run `make tokens`.

canvas.$description: The page background behind everything. Do not use on a tile or card: separate layers with surface.

surface.$description: Cards, tiles, and inputs sitting on canvas; layers are separated by this tone. Do not add a border or shadow to it, and do not nest surface on surface.

ink.$description: Primary text and numbers on canvas or surface. Do not use on inverse or accent fills.

ink-muted.$description: Subtitles and supporting labels under ink. Do not use for values a dispatcher must act on.

ink-faint.$description: Least important readable text: timestamps, axis labels, metadata. Do not use for body text or anything required to complete a task.

accent.$description: Primary action, active state, or the single highlighted data point. Max one accent element per view. Do not use for decoration or for rescue priority: use status colors.

accent-tint.$description: Quiet background behind an accent-related destructive or secondary action. Do not use as a general highlight or for body text blocks.

inverse.$description: Feature tiles that must stand apart from surface cards, and sparing emphasis such as a selected segment. Do not use for whole sections or more than a few tiles per view.

ink-on-inverse.$description: Text and icons on inverse only. Do not use on canvas or surface.

ink-on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent fills only. Do not use elsewhere.

reward.$description: Fill for positive milestones such as completed rescues in a summary. Graphic use only: put ink-on-fill on it, never use it as text. Do not use for warnings or priority.

growth.$description: Fill for progress and confirmed-safe states. Graphic use only: put ink-on-fill on it, never use it as text. Do not use for call-to-action buttons.

ink-on-fill.$description: Text and icons on reward and growth fills, dark in both themes. Do not use elsewhere.

status-critical.$description: P1 Critical badges and pins. Exempt from the one-accent rule because priority must read at a glance. Always pair with the text label. Do not use for buttons or errors.

status-high.$description: P2 High badges and pins, always with the text label. Do not use for anything but priority.

status-moderate.$description: P3 Moderate badges and pins, always with the text label. Do not use for anything but priority.

status-info.$description: P4 Info badges and pins, always with the text label. Do not use for anything but priority.

ink-on-status.$description: Text on status fills only. Do not use elsewhere.

display.$description: The number that matters: one per card. Do not use for sentences.

body-bold.$description: Row labels, button text, and emphasis inside body.

body.$description: Default reading text. Original resident messages use this size.

caption-bold.$description: Badges and short flags beside metadata. Not for sentences.

caption.$description: Metadata and chart labels. The smallest size allowed.

tile.$description: Small tiles nested in a layout, and inputs.

fast.$description: Hover, press, and small state changes.

base.$description: Content arriving, such as a new row.

loop.$description: One cycle of a repeating signal. Stays above 1 second so nothing flashes.

2.$description: Focus outlines, the critical pulse, spinners, and map pin rings. Not for separating layers: use tone.

none.$description: The default. Layers are separated by tone, not shadow.

sheet.$description: Only for a bottom sheet floating over content. Do not use on cards, tiles, or buttons.
